shortDescription: IB Physics Prep: Planetwick helps IB Physics SL and HL students practise, understand and revise. It works offline, with no account.
longDescription:
IB Physics Prep: Planetwick helps IB Physics SL and HL students practise, understand and revise. It works offline, with no account.

### Learn Your Way
- Syllabus view: follow the five themes in order, A Space, time and motion; B The particulate nature of matter; C Wave behaviour; D Fields; E Nuclear and quantum physics.
- Real-World view: build things, from a safe roller-coaster loop to a wave measurement plan, and meet the physics exactly when each step needs it. Your builds go on a Made-it shelf.
- Switch between the two views at any time. Your progress is shared.
- SL and HL toggle: HL-only content stays hidden at SL.

### Practise and Adapt
- Short quizzes after every lesson, with question lengths of 5, 10, 20 or all.
- Wrong answers link straight to the material you missed, with a one-line reason for what to study next.
- Unit tests, mixed practice and mock-style sets with a report and study plan.
- Command-term trainer: learn what Define, Explain, Calculate, Evaluate and the others ask for, then drill them.
- Internal assessment coach: checklists and questions that help you plan your own investigation. It never writes your work.

### See It Move
- Interactive labs for projectile motion, springs, double slit, radioactive decay, the photoelectric effect, gas laws and circuits.

### Readable and Honest
- Text zoom from 50 to 300 percent, with large, clear type.
- Optional Other boards chip and Curriculum map show where a topic has similar content in A Level and AP courses.
- Every question and explanation is original. Topic names and SL/HL levels follow the published IB Physics subject brief; check your own guide and teacher for exact requirements.
